meta.name: litert-quantization-calib
meta.description: Assists the user to calibrate, merge, and statically quantize litert LLM models (such as Gemma 3) in standard open-source (OSS) environments. Use when the user wants to run LLM calibration, merge task JSON results, align KV cache parameters across models, protect sensitive layers in Float32, or run quantized inference testing. Don't use for JAX/PyTorch custom quantization configurations or non-litert models.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校准、合并并静态量化LiteRT大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在标准开源环境中对LiteRT模型做量化部署
copy.tagline_en: Calibrate, merge, and statically quantize LiteRT LLM models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quantize LiteRT models for deployment in open-source environments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你对 LiteRT 大模型（如 Gemma 3）进行校准、合并校准结果、静态量化（A8W8/A16W8）、保护敏感层（Float32）、对齐 KV 缓存参数，并运行量化后的推理测试。
howto.when: 当你需要校准 LiteRT 模型、合并多个校准 JSON 文件、静态量化模型套件、保护 RMS Norm 等层、对齐 KV 缓存参数，或测试量化模型推理时触发。

say.text: 帮我校准 Gemma 3 1B 模型，使用对话数据集。
say.note: Claude 会指导你运行校准命令，生成校准范围 JSON。

say.text: 合并两个校准任务的结果文件。
say.note: Claude 会指导你运行合并脚本，生成统一的校准文件。

say.text: 对模型进行 A8W8 量化，并保护 RMS Norm 层。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to calibrate LiteRT LLMs (e.g., Gemma 3), merge calibration results, statically quantize (A8W8/A16W8), protect sensitive layers in Float32, align KV cache parameters, and run quantized inference tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to calibrate a LiteRT model, merge multiple calibration JSON files, statically quantize a model suite, protect RMS Norm layers, align KV cache parameters, or test quantized model inference.

say_en.text: Help me calibrate Gemma 3 1B model using a conversation dataset.
Merge the results from two calibration tasks.
Quantize the model to A8W8 and protect RMS Norm layers.
